component.name: QSSTV-Experimental
component.summary: Amateur radio slow-scan television and digital SSTV (DRM)

description.p: QSSTV-Experimental sends and receives amateur radio slow-scan television (SSTV) pictures and digital SSTV over DRM, using your sound card and optionally a rig-control connection.
It is built upon the original QSSTV by Johan Maes, ON4QZ, and adds new modes, an improved receiver, decoding of recordings from files, and batch operation from the command line.
